description: This file contains abstract test cases for the GlobalErrorRegistry in the Eclipse Ditto project, focusing on classpath annotation checks, exception registration, and parsing logic verification.

classes.name: GlobalErrorRegistryTestCases
classes.description: Abstract class defining test cases for error handling and exception classpath consistency in Apollo

methods.name: sampleCheckForExceptionFromEachModule
methods.description: Verifies that all annotated exception classes are present in the class index

methods.name: ensureSamplesAreComplete
methods.description: Ensures that all exception packages are included in the sample classes list

methods.name: getPackagesDistinct
methods.description: Helper method to obtain distinct packages from a collection of classes

methods.name: allExceptionsRegistered
methods.description: Checks that all subclasses of DittoRuntimeException (except DittoJsonException) are annotated with JsonParsableException

methods.name: allRegisteredExceptionsContainAMethodToParseFromJson
methods.description: Verifies that each exception class annotated with JsonParsableException has a method to parse JSON

methods.name: assertAnnotationIsValid
methods.description: Validates that the annotation's method exists in the class
